Canning–Larson Lemma 10.6 gives O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C≅omega_C⊗gamma^*omega_{P1}^{-1}, deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f, and the Serre-dual evaluation obstruction. Hence deg W_5=16, h^0(W_5)=11, while deg W_4=20 and h^0(W_4)=15. For a degree-six divisor Gamma, H^1(W_4(-Gamma))=0 because deg W_4(-Gamma)=14>2g-2=10, so the W_4 evaluation is surjective and local matrix reduction gives Fit_0(coker phi)=I_12(phi)=I_6(phi_5). The W_5 cokernel is dual to H^0(omega_C⊗W_5^{-1}(Gamma)), a degree-zero line bundle; it is one-dimensional exactly when that bundle is trivial and otherwise zero. Thus Z_ev is the rank-five locus and corank at most one everywhere, so deeper degeneracy is empty. The expected maximal-minor codimensions are (11-5)(6-5)=6 for phi_5 and (26-11)(12-11)=15 for phi. Writing D=gamma^*O(1), the CE normalization yields W_5≅omega_C^2(-D), so Z_ev is the reduced-support ordered open in |omega_C(-D)|. Canning–Larson Example 5.7 identifies (E,F)=((3,3,3),(4,5)) as the genus-six generic CE stratum and places hyperelliptic covers in the distinct ((1,4,4),(2,7)) stratum. Consequently h^0(D)=2 by Clifford, and Riemann–Roch gives h^0(omega_C(-D))=3. Because E is balanced, omega_C(-D) is the restriction of O_{P2}(1), hence is basepoint-free and has reduced general divisors. Therefore Z_ev is nonempty of dimension 2 and has codimension 4 in the six-dimensional Conf_6(C). At Gamma in Z_ev, the dual of da_N is restriction H^0(omega_C)->H^0(omega_C|_Gamma), whose kernel is H^0(omega_C(-Gamma))≅H^0(D), of dimension 2; thus corank(da_N)=2=6-4. This is compatible with FND-0046 because the Fitting comparison is supplied, with FND-0083 because balanced E supplies basepoint-freeness rather than relying only on Riemann–Roch, with FND-0096 because codimension 6 is the Picard-side determinantal expectation while the pullback Abel–Jacobi differential has corank 2, and with FND-0097/FND-0099 because the audit is fiberwise split and explicitly uses the required W_4 vanishings. The finding adds the exact fiberwise numerical rank-drop statement and should not be merged.
